RollPoolAura.title: RollPoolAura
RollPoolAura.description: A validated 3D aura configuration published into the shared cross-device Roll Pool.

id.description: Unique aura identifier matching the document ID.

enabled.description: Whether the aura is currently active in the Roll Pool.

baseOdds.description: 1-in-N base odds for rolling this aura.

authorUid.description: UID of the creator who wrote this aura.

project.description: Native map containing the validated AuraProject definition (layers, rarity, environment, textures, and optional spatial audio).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the aura was added to Firestore.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the aura was last updated.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Trusted administrator record for Roll Pool management.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was created.

/rollPool/{auraId}.description: Publicly readable Roll Pool of custom 3D auras managed by the creator.
